scope: Bounded static disassembly of the candidate spatial query called by the native Split worker.
observations: The function compares the query box against node bounds and skips nodes without overlap.
When the node item range is empty it visits up to eight non-null child pointers in ascending slot order recursively.
Otherwise it appends pointers from the node item range to a collector list in range order.
limitations: Static decompiler inference from one bounded code range. Construction and item insertion order, node layout and leaf criterion require independent validation; no runtime entry binding is claimed for this candidate.

entryPrefixBinding.scope: Both worker and query entry prefixes match the current running process; this does not verify every instruction or prove query invocation.
